summary: Evaluate ML opportunities, estimate pilot value and create a decision-ready roadmap. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Machine learning for business strategy helps strategists and functional leaders assess where it can support decisions and whether a pilot is feasible. You’ll use CRISP-DM to frame business problems, score opportunities by value, feasibility and risk, estimate costs and benefits, assess data readiness, interpret a confusion matrix and outline governance ownership and pilot milestones.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who assess, sponsor or translate machine-learning opportunities into business decisions and pilot plans.
modules: ML Portfolio Roadmap and Executive Cases
prerequisites: No prior machine-learning or coding experience is required. Familiarity with business planning and organizational data is useful. Exercises use Excel for scenario calculations.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
